<p>
I am a public health researcher with a Master of Public Health
(MPH) in Biostatistics and an Advanced Certificate in Epidemiology
from Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health.
I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Financial Mathematics
from Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University.
</p>

<p>
My research interests focus on survival analysis,
statistical learning, and causal inference, particularly
their applications in cancer epidemiology and population health.
